mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS sessionId, summary, through_message_id AS throughMessageId, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_session_summary WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session_summary (session_id, summary, through_message_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{summary}, #{throughMessageId}, datetime('now','localtime')) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = excluded.summary, through_message_id = excluded.through_message_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE chat_session_summary.through_message_id < excluded.through_message_id
